🔥 The fire settles. Daniyar has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael asks "We've been walking past those." Katarina breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Daniyar lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

tableLines.line: ⛓️ Ashford doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Klaus speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

Riley: "Daylily Bud is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Katarina: "Daylily Bud is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Klaus: "Deadly Nightshade is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
With Haven grieving, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
